page: Microsoft Azure HB120-96rs_v3 is a high-performance virtual machine from the HBv3 server family, running on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. It features 96 dedicated vCPUs based on the x86_64 architecture, paired with an Intel processor. The system is equipped with 456.0 GB of system memory, yielding a memory-to-core ratio of 4.75 GB per core.

For storage and connectivity, the HB120-96rs_v3 includes a bundled 2412 GB local NVMe SSD and supports Premium Storage. The instance is also RDMA (Remote Direct Memory Access) capable, enabling low-latency, high-throughput networking across clusters. No dedicated GPU hardware is present on this server configuration.

The combination of dedicated compute resources, high-speed local NVMe storage, and RDMA capability makes this server highly cost-efficient for distributed parallel workloads. It is optimized for high-performance computing (HPC) applications, large-scale scientific simulations, clustered database workloads, and intensive data processing tasks that require fast node-to-node communication.
